:::{#exr-matvec-mult-practice}
#### Computing a matrix-vector product entry by entry

Each entry of a [matrix-vector product](#def-matvec-mult) $\matr{A}\vx$
combines one [row of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-row) with $\vx$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 & 4},
\qquad
\vx = \sbmat{1 \\ 2 \\ -1}.
$$

Find $\matr{A}\vx$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @def-matvec-mult with $m = 2$ and $p = 3$.

:::

:::
